items.ref: Tlala, lehuma, botlhokatiro le go tlhoka tekatekano ke dingwe tse re tshwanetseng go lwana le tsona ka dikakanyo tsotlhe tsa rona mme jaaka re tlogela leina la Mmasepala wa selegae la Mbizana, re tshwanetse gape go netefatsa gore re dira ka natla go tlogela dilo tsotlhe tse di neng di le morwalo mo go bathong ba rona.

items.hyp: Tonakgolo ya Mokgatlho wa Setšhaba le Dikgwebo tsa Setšhaba (COGTA), Dr Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o tlhokafetse ka kgwetlho ya go tlhokafala Mbizana le Winnie Madikizela Mandela mo Molelekwa wa Local Municipality.
items.ref: Tona ya Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), Ngk Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a tsenetse moletlo o wa semmuso wa go fetola leina la Mbizana go nna Mmasepala wa selegae wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

items.hyp: Moporesidente wa moletlong wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa Mafumbatha a re go na le dipalo tse di tshwanang go tlhokafala baagi ba fa tlase go tlhoka go tlhokafala mo kgetseng e e tlhokego ya kgosigadi.
items.ref: Mmeyara wa Masepala o montšha o o tswang go kaiwa ka leina le le ntšha la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa  Mafumbatha o rile, go na le mananeo a rulagantsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba lefelo le ba ungwa sengwe  go tswa mo segakeng sa tokologo.

items.hyp: Mafumbatha a re go tsaya moletlo wa ga mafakelokeng go tlhoka go tswa go baetsimaelo.
items.ref: Mafumbatha o dumela gore go fetola leina la mmasepala go tla ngokela babeeletsi go feta.

items.hyp: Winnie Madikizela Mandela o ne a le mmino wa tshwanetse go bona mo mafelong a gagwe, go tlaa tshwanetse go dira gore go tlaa tshwanela go dira gore go tla go dira gape, le fa re tla go dira gape gore go dirwa ga Mama Winnie.
items.ref: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela o ne a le mogaka wa boditšhabatšhaba jaanong go reela mmasepala ka leina la gagwe go tlile go dira gore tlhabololo ya rona e gole ka bonako, mme gape re bua ka boswa jwa Mme Winnie.

items.hyp: Batho ba tlaa tshwanela go bontsha le go bontsha, go na le diphitlhelelo tse di tlang.
items.ref: Batho ba tla goroga go bona sefikantswe,  e bile go na le mananeo a a ka rulagantsweng teng.

items.hyp: Motsamaisi wa dipotso wa dipatlisiso kwa Frere Hospital kwa Kapa Bophirima, Dr David Stead o latofadiwa gore go tlaa nna le tsamaiso ya go tsamaisa moletlo mo go tsa kwa ntle ga moletlo wa kgwedi ya Letsatsi e le e tlaa tshwara go lebelela dipotso tsa coronavirus mo dikgwedi tse di tlang.
items.ref: Moitseanape wa malwetse a a tshelanang kwa Bookelong jwa Frere kwa Kapa Botlhaba, Ngk David Stead,  o tlhagisitse matshwenyego a gore tsweletso ya go nwa notagi kwa mafelong ka nako ya maikhutso a paseka a beke e telele a ka oketsa  ditshwaetso  tsa Khorona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.

items.hyp: Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o bua la gale gore go tlhoka tlhokego ya botlhokatiro mo go tswa go kgwedi ya Fela go kgwedi ya Mopitlwe, mme botlhokatiro jo bo tlaa tshwanang go tlhoka tlhokego ya botlhokasi mo diketetsi tsa diphologolo, mo bareng e e tsamaisiwang le mo tlhophong.
